testcase.name: step-target-unknown

testcase.name: edge-missing

testcase.name: step-unreachable

testcase.name: step-dead-end
testcase.failure: examples/bad/support-voice.yaml:31: The step "fault_logged" (type message) has no step after it and is not marked as an end, so the conversation stops there with nothing for the user to do.

testcase.name: flow-trap
testcase.failure: examples/bad/support-voice.yaml:51: The step "retry_loop_a" is in a loop with no way out: from here no end, no handover and no dead end can be reached. examples/bad/support-voice.yaml:56: The step "retry_loop_b" is in a loop with no way out: from here no end, no handover and no dead end can be reached.

testcase.name: input-no-fallback
testcase.failure: examples/bad/support-voice.yaml:12: The choice step "ask_topic" has no fallback, so nothing says what happens when the answer does not match. examples/bad/support-voice.yaml:25: The input step "ask_postcode" has no fallback, so nothing says what happens when the answer does not match.

testcase.name: input-no-reprompt-limit
testcase.failure: examples/bad/support-voice.yaml:25: The input step "ask_postcode" has no reprompt_limit, so nothing says how many times the user is asked again.

testcase.name: reprompt-limit-high
testcase.failure: examples/bad/support-voice.yaml:23: The choice step "ask_topic" asks again up to 6 times; the limit is 3 (--max-reprompts).

testcase.name: no-handover
testcase.failure: examples/bad/support-voice.yaml:4: The flow has 3 steps that wait for the user and no step of type handover, so there is no way to a person.

testcase.name: voice-multiple-questions
testcase.failure: examples/bad/support-voice.yaml:14: The prompt of the step "ask_topic" has 3 question marks. A caller can answer one question at a time.

testcase.name: voice-prompt-too-long
testcase.failure: examples/bad/support-voice.yaml:9: The prompt of the step "greeting" has 35 words; the limit is 30 (--max-words).

testcase.name: irreversible-unconfirmed
testcase.failure: examples/bad/support-voice.yaml:42: The step "take_payment" cannot be undone (action "take_card_payment") and runs without a confirm step before it: "ask_amount" (next) leads to it without a confirmation.

testcase.name: ai-disclosure-missing
testcase.failure: examples/bad/support-voice.yaml:9: The opening of the flow ("greeting" and "ask_topic") does not tell the user that they are talking to an automated system or an AI. Article 50 of the EU AI Act asks that people are told when they interact with an AI system, unless that is obvious from the circumstances.
